\section{Caption System Test Suite}

This document demonstrates caption typography and quantum-derived spacing optimized for TeX Gyre Pagella.

\subsection{Table Captions (Above Content)}

Tables follow Chicago Manual of Style with captions placed above the content.

\begin{table}[tbp]
  \caption{Economic Growth Rates by Region, 1960–1990}
  \label{tab:growth-rates}
  \centering
  \begin{threeparttable}
    \begin{tabular}{@{}lcccc@{}}
      \toprule
      Country & 1960–1970 & 1970–1980 & 1980–1990 & Average \\
      \midrule
      Japan & 10.5\% & 4.5\% & 4.0\% & 6.3\% \\
      South Korea & 8.6\% & 7.0\% & 8.5\% & 8.0\% \\
      Taiwan & 9.2\% & 9.5\% & 7.7\% & 8.8\% \\
      Singapore & 8.8\% & 8.5\% & 6.5\% & 7.9\% \\
      \bottomrule
    \end{tabular}
    \begin{tablenotes}
      \item \emph{Notes:} Growth rates are annual averages calculated using constant 2010 USD. All figures are seasonally adjusted.
      \item \emph{Source:} World Bank Development Indicators (2023).
    \end{tablenotes}
  \end{threeparttable}
\end{table}

\subsection{Figure Captions (Below Content)}

Figures follow Chicago style with captions below the content. Labels are bold and separated from the text by a period.

\begin{figure}[tbp]
  \centering
  \rule{0.8\textwidth}{0.4\textwidth}% Placeholder for figure
  \caption{Export Composition by Technology Level for Selected Economies. This longer caption demonstrates full-width, ragged-right treatment across multiple lines.}
  \label{fig:export-comp}
  \begin{lanepaperfigurenotes}
    \emph{Notes:} The technology classification follows Lall (2000). High-tech exports include electronics, pharmaceuticals, and aerospace products.
  \end{lanepaperfigurenotes}
\end{figure}

\subsection{Grid Alignment Verification}

The spacing system uses quantum-derived caption separation:
\begin{itemize}
\item Tables: 9.9pt (0.75 quantum) before caption, 6.6pt (0.5 quantum) after
\item Figures: 9.9pt (0.75 quantum) before caption, 13.2pt (1 quantum) after
\end{itemize}

\begin{table}[tbp]
  \caption{Grid Alignment Test}
  \centering
  \begin{tabular}{@{}lc@{}}
    \toprule
    Spacing Element & Grid Units \\
    \midrule
    Before table caption & 0.75 \\
    After table caption & 0.5 \\
    Before figure caption & 0.75 \\
    After figure caption & 1.0 \\
    \bottomrule
  \end{tabular}
\end{table}
